name: Sunken Temple: the creatures of the Avatar of Hakkar event attack the player who started it (#11443)
contract: Using the Hakkar Worship Altar 2310500 summons the Shade of Hakkar 8440, whose SmartAI summons Hakkari
Bloodkeepers 8438 (first after 15 s at -434.5, 288.3) and Nightmare Suppressors 8497 (first after 10 s at
-510.1, 287.4). #11443: the Bloodkeepers attacked the closest player and the Suppressors walked to the Shade, so
the player who started the event was not their target. Every creature the event summons now fixates on that player
while the event runs. The starter stands at the altar; a second player of the group stands next to the first
Bloodkeeper's summon point, so a closest-player pick would take the bystander. Health fixtures keep both alive.
Both players join world phase 1, where the altar and the event's creatures are.

A Bloodkeeper that the bystander pulls on spawn still turns to the starter: its Shadow Bolt 12471, cast at its victim, goes there. Its Corruption picks a random enemy and may still take the bystander.
